reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: updateMemberAdmin is called at MemberManagementClient.tsx:253 (non-test caller). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json. Gate 3: src/lib/actions/ is explicitly in scope. Spec deviation is real — the DELETE (L449-453) and INSERT (L460-461) are two separate autocommitted Supabase REST calls with no wrapping transaction; if DELETE commits and INSERT fails the member loses all team assignments permanently. Attack path is uncertain because exploitation requires a transient error window between the two calls rather than direct attacker-controlled input, so verdict is CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY.
